info.name: DesignHub Mobile API
info.description:
Complete API v1 collection for the DesignHub embroidery marketplace (Laravel + Sanctum).

Setup:
1. Import this collection.
2. The collection uses the LAN API URL `http://192.168.1.7:8000/api/v1`. Both devices must be on the same network.
3. Run **Authentication → Request OTP (Register)**. Local development uses the static OTP `1234`.
4. Run **Verify OTP (Register)**. Use the matching Login requests for an existing phone number. The test script saves `accessToken` automatically.
5. All authenticated requests use Bearer `{{accessToken}}`.

Success responses always contain `success`, `message`, and `data`. Paginated responses also contain `meta` and `links`. Errors contain `success: false`, `message`, and `code`; validation errors also contain field-level `errors`. List endpoints accept `page` and `per_page` (maximum 100).

exec: pm.test('Has success message', () => pm.expect(json.data.message).to.eql('OTP sent successfully.'));
